basics.name: Xiaoqi Luo
basics.label: M.Eng. Candidate in Control Engineering · Embodied AI & BCI
basics.summary: Master's student at Hangzhou Dianzi University working on embodied AI, multimodal time-series learning, and brain-computer interfaces.

work.name: Genrobot.ai
work.summary: Worked on heterogeneous hand-exoskeleton retargeting, hand-arm teleoperation, cross-embodiment replay, and contact-rich in-hand manipulation Sim-to-Real.
highlights: Developed HKT geometry-conditioned cross-attention for calibration-efficient retargeting across heterogeneous hand exoskeletons.
Built Ego-SMPL replay adapters for Tianji-Wuji and Unitree G1/SONIC, and MANUS+VIVE hand-arm teleoperation using relative SE(3), One-Euro filtering, and Marvin SDK IK.

work.name: Unitree Robotics
work.summary: Designed a human-in-the-loop post-training approach for G1 loco-manipulation.
highlights: Separated autonomous rollout, corrective intervention, and recovery trajectories to identify high-value actions for VLA post-training.

work.name: Pudu Robotics
work.summary: Worked on VLA embodiment adaptation, evaluation, real-robot reinforcement learning, and inference acceleration.
highlights: Reproduced and deployed GR00T-N1.5; built SFT, offline-RL, and online-RL workflows for wheeled dual-arm manipulation.

work.name: Anker Innovations
work.summary: Worked on VLA evaluation, multimodal robot-data pipelines, and real-robot deployment.
highlights: Built data-quality evaluation and asynchronous multimodal data processing pipelines; deployed InternVLA-N1 to Unitree Go2.

work.name: Westlake University CenBRAIN Lab
work.summary: Worked on invasive BCI speech decoding from sEEG.
highlights: Built a Chinese sentence reconstruction pipeline using initial, final, and tone decoding with Beam Search and LLM reranking.
Automation (Artificial Intelligence) School; advisor: Prof. Yunyuan Gao.

publications.name: NeuralIntent: Bridging Noninvasive EEG and Embodied Foundation Models with Continuous Neural Intent Tokens
publications.summary: First author. Introduces continuous neural intent tokens and EIG-Bench.

publications.name: Progressive Cross-Modal Attention Network for BCI Decoding Using EEG and fNIRS
Neurovascular Alignment and Reliability-Aware Fusion for Continuous EEG-fNIRS Emotion Regression
publications.publisher: IEEE Transactions on Affective Computing (Minor Revision Returned, Under Review)

projects.name: ExoFactor / HKT
projects.summary: Geometry-conditioned cross-attention for calibration-efficient retargeting of heterogeneous hand exoskeletons.
highlights: FK to topology-independent geometry tokens to Hand21 and dexterous-hand mapping.

projects.name: Ego Motion Cross-Embodiment Replay
projects.summary: Unified SMPL and Hand21 motion replay for Tianji-Wuji and Unitree G1/SONIC.
highlights: Offline synchronized replay on a shared timeline; real-time streaming is the next step.

projects.name: MANUS + VIVE Hand-Arm Teleoperation
projects.summary: Decoupled hand and arm teleoperation for Wuji Hand2 and Tianji arm.
highlights: Relative SE(3), One-Euro filtering, explicit zero capture, and Tianji Marvin SDK IK.
